Title: [LSJ] Does S:CE protect like a dodge?

Messages.Body:
Hi,

RTR120204 states that
Dodge protects the dodger against all strikes, even aggressive S:CE effects
(like Catatonic Fear).Does S:CE protect the user in the same fashion?Just to

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
pallando wrote:
> Hi,
>
> RTR120204 states that
> Dodge protects the dodger against all strikes, even aggressive S:CE effects
> (like Catatonic Fear).Does S:CE protect the user in the same fashion?Just to

No. S:CE protects in a different fashion -- it ends combat.

CF is ending combat already, so an extra end combat effect won't do
anything interesting there -- the CF will still inflict 1 damage
after combat ends.

> be sure, is the not untap clause in Flash Grenade an aggressive S:CE effect,
> i.e. included in the protection?-- regards

Dodge will avoid the "tap and do not untap" effect of Flash Grenade, yes.
